objective: Build the largest defensible PIT backtest universe and richest event-level information set possible before any new linked-asset outcome reveal.
independence_rule: canonical_event_id remains the default inferential unit; contracts, venues, horizons, assets, quotes and ticks add information but never automatically add independent N.
stop_rule: Stop expansion only when remaining routes are immaterial, fail PIT/provenance/reproducibility, are economically unjustified, or are infeasible under time/cost constraints.

earnings_ir_capacity_probe.interpretation: The frozen issuer-IR discovery/navigation route failed its preregistered technical capacity gate. This does not establish absence of issuer IR or official earnings evidence.

execution_order: W4-C ACTIVE: R1 baseline + FDA extension materialized -> earnings IR capacity probe materialized negative -> promote exact result -> transport/navigation diagnosis -> preregister new technical route or close earnings subroute -> reapply saturation gate -> remaining R1/R2-R7 only if justified

continue_if_any: material increase in independent canonical events
material increase in pre-event temporal depth
material increase in economically justified breadth
material improvement in provenance or reproducibility
stop_if_all: remaining candidate sources add immaterial marginal coverage
remaining acquisition is infeasible under challenge time/cost constraints

immediate_next_actions: Promote byte-identically the four frozen capacity-probe result outputs from w4c-r1-earnings-ir-discovery-probe-result-v1 to main and verify their recorded SHA-256 identities
Freeze the negative ROUTE_INFEASIBLE_CURRENT_PROTOCOL result as authoritative without changing the sample, thresholds, executor, or matching rules
Perform an outcome-blind transport/navigation diagnosis to determine whether the 0/40 result is caused by search transport/parser/ranking limitations rather than absence of issuer IR

If a materially different transport route is justified, preregister and byte-freeze it as a new protocol before any new external requests; otherwise close the earnings issuer-IR subroute under current capabilities
Reapply the W4-C Saturation Gate after the R1 subroute decision before advancing to another R1 subroute or R2
Keep linked-asset realized outcomes, prediction-market performance, ARGOS PnL, and n_final_backtestable closed until their authorized phase
explicitly_forbidden_now: running the frozen current issuer-IR executor across all 1355 earnings groups after a failed capacity gate
changing the 40-event sample after observing the capacity result
changing capacity thresholds after observing the result
using earnings numeric outcomes, prediction-market settlement/performance, realized returns, or ARGOS PnL to design the next transport route
forbidden_before_W4_H: post-hoc feature selection using economic performance
changing the frozen W4-B family dictionary to inflate counts
mutating frozen W4-B truth during W4-C extensions

relationship_to_prior_science.rule: W4 is a separate post-freeze experiment program, never a rescue or reinterpretation of the frozen confirmatory result.
